name: Mickey's arrangement: the envelope to the landing
when: night one after 22:00; asks on nights 1, 3, 5, 7
offer: Aye. Well. Envelope still wants carrying.

keys.how: from the hook by the dark coat

steps.words: Ron: Mickey's arrangement, down to the ferry landing after ten.
lines: Ron: Mickey's arrangement, down to the ferry landing after ten.

steps.verb: carry it to the landing, 22:00 to 01:00

keys.how: the yards' lane behind the warehouses, slow in the dark (footsteps carry half as far)
the cab (quickest; anyone who sees it names the car)

steps.words: At the landing a man says 'Mickey's?'
lines: At the landing a man says 'Mickey's?'

steps.verb: take the cut back for the tin

keys.how: hand it over and take the cut
open it first (a carbon of the night's fare sheet)
stand and be searched (the constable keeps the envelope; the ask goes on as a state)

pay.note: economy: Frank's cut a run, nights one, three, five and seven of Act I

ledger: An envelope to the landing, for Mickey's arrangement.
returns: the line in the book next morning (Sheila); Ron's look
